verdict.rationale: The H200 ships with a software stack (CUDA, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM), so asking whether users can opt out of telemetry is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about telemetry, usage tracking, or opt-out controls. The 'Confidential Computing Supported' item is an adjacent data-protection feature, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
